rationale: E10 tested a weekly reminder for Monday and Wednesday at 8:00 AM in America/New_York, ending on 31 December 2026. The repaired app returned one reminder with the first occurrence on 2 March 2026 at 8:00 AM (UTC-05:00). It preserved both weekdays, the weekly frequency, and the end date. All three E10 samples passed. In the initial run, all three E10 samples failed schema validation. An intermediate rerun produced valid JSON but still got the action count and other reminder details wrong. The final repair constrained the generated response using scheduling details derived from the request. Initial report · Why this supports ACCEPT: E10 shows that a previously failing recurrence case now preserves the user’s schedule. Across the full benchmark, 72 of 72 samples passed against the 90% threshold. The property and service checks passed, and the safety override did not trigger.
